Form.Condition: MonolinePolicyType[.!='Kidnap/Ransom And Extortion'] and PackagePolicyType[.!='Kidnap/Ransom And Extortion'] and MonolinePolicyType[.!='Commercial Fidelity And Forgery'] and MonolinePolicyType[.!='Government Fidelity And Forgery']

Form.Name: Add Protective Devices Or Services Summary
Add Protective Devices Or Services Detail
Form.ParentName: Add Protective Devices Or Services Summary

Field.Label:
Item 1. The burglar alarm system shown below will be:
  • Maintained in proper working order; and
  • Connected at all times;
    when the "premises" is not open for business.
&nbsp Watchperson(s) with no other duties, that you employ exclusively, will be on duty inside the "premises" while closed for business. Each will make at least hourly rounds and will:
a. Register at least hourly on a clock
Item 3. The "premises" is equipped with a bullet resisting enclosure for which you hold an unexpired Underwriters' Laboratories, Inc. certificate.
Item 4. The "premises" is equipped with a bullet resisting enclosure and alarm system for which you hold an unexpired Underwriters' Laboratories, Inc. certificate.
State the number of guard(s) that will be on duty inside the "premises" or at its door while regularly open for business.
Item 6. The "premises" is equipped with a holdup alarm connected with:
A police station with one regular police officer on duty at all times.
A local gong inside or outside the "premises".
Holds an unexpired Underwriters' Laboratories, Inc. certificate.
Item 8. Covered property will be conveyed outside the "premises" in the following:
A locked safe or chest bolted or welded inside a vehicle.
An Underwriters' Laboratories, Inc. approved messenger protective bag.

Script.Data: if ( typeof(document.form1.XPath_EFTAccountNumber) == 'undefined') { alert('ConfirmRoutingNumberISOGLCW : Account Number is undefined'); return; } if ( typeof(document.form1.XPath_ConfirmAccountNumber) == 'undefined') { alert('ConfirmRoutingNumberISOGLCW : Confirm Account Number is undefined'); return; } var Account = document.form1.XPath_EFTAccountNumber; var ConfirmAccount = document.form1.XPath_ConfirmAccountNumber; if (Account.value == "") { ConfirmAccount.value = ""; return; } else { var reMatch = /^\d{1,32}$/; if (!reMatch.test(Account.value)) { alert("Account Number must be numeric"); Account.value = ""; Account.focus(); return; } if ((!reMatch.test(ConfirmAccount.value)) && (ConfirmAccount.value != "")) { alert("Confirm Account Number must be numeric"); ConfirmAccount.value = ""; ConfirmAccount.focus(); return; } if ((Account.value != ConfirmAccount.value) && (ConfirmAccount.value != "")) { alert("Confirm Account Number does not match Account Number, \nplease re-enter Confirm Account Number"); ConfirmAccount.value = ""; ConfirmAccount.focus(); return; } }
Script.Comment: Validate that Confirm Account number and Account number match and are numeric.

Script.Name: ConfirmRoutingNumberISOGLCW
Script.Title: Confirm Routing Number
Script.Data: if ( typeof(document.form1.XPath_EFTBankRoutingNumber) == 'undefined') { alert('ConfirmRoutingNumberISOGLCW : Routing Number is undefined'); return; } if ( typeof(document.form1.XPath_ConfirmBankRoutingNumber) == 'undefined') { alert('ConfirmRoutingNumberISOGLCW : Confirm Routing Number is undefined'); return; } Routing = document.form1.XPath_EFTBankRoutingNumber; ConfirmRouting = document.form1.XPath_ConfirmBankRoutingNumber; if (Routing.value == "") { ConfirmRouting.value = ""; return; } else { var reMatch = /\d{9}/; if (!reMatch.test(Routing.value)) { alert("Routing Number must be a 9 digit number"); Routing.value = ""; Routing.focus(); return; } if ((!reMatch.test(ConfirmRouting.value)) && (ConfirmRouting.value != "")) { alert("Confirm Routing Number must be a 9 digit number"); ConfirmRouting.value = ""; ConfirmRouting.focus(); return; } if ((Routing.value != ConfirmRouting.value) && (ConfirmRouting.value != "")) { alert("Confirm Routing Number does not match Routing Number, \nplease re-enter Confirm Routing Number"); ConfirmRouting.value = ""; ConfirmRouting.focus(); return; } }
Script.Comment: Validate Routing Number, and Confirm Routing number match, and are numeric.

Script.Name: DeductDisableField
Script.Title: Disable Deductible Field
Script.Comment: This script will disable the CrimeInsuringAgreement.Deduct field when the CrimeInsuringAgreement.Type = "Lessees Of Safe Deposit Boxes", "Employee Theft - Name Schedule", "Employee Theft - Position Schedule" or "Securities Deposited With Others".

Script.Name: DeductNullMessage
Script.Title: Deductible Null Message
Script.Comment: This script will display the message "A Deductible Amount Must Be Entered For the Insuring Agreement Selected." when CrimeInsuringAgreement.Deduct field = "Null" and the CrimeInsuringAgreement.Type <> "Lessees Of Safe Deposit Boxes", "Employee Theft - Name Schedule", "Employee Theft - Position Schedule" or "Securities Deposited With Others".

Script.Name: DisableConfirmAccountNumberISOGLCW
Script.Title: Disable Confirm Account Number
Script.Data: if ( typeof(document.form1.XPath_EFTAccountNumber) == 'undefined' ) { alert('DisableConfirmAccountNumberISOGLCW : Account Number is undefined'); return; } if ( typeof(document.form1.XPath_ConfirmAccountNumber) == 'undefined' ) { alert('DisableConfirmAccountNumberISOGLCW : Confirm Account Number is undefined'); return; } AccountNumber = document.form1.XPath_EFTAccountNumber; Confirm = document.form1.XPath_ConfirmAccountNumber; DisableFieldFocus(AccountNumber,Confirm,"");
Script.Comment: Disable the Confirm Account number element when Account Number is blank.

Script.Name: DisableConfirmRoutingNumberISOGLCW
Script.Title: Disable Confirm Routing Number
Script.Data: if ( typeof(document.form1.XPath_EFTBankRoutingNumber) == 'undefined' ) { alert('DisableConfirmRoutingNumberISOGLCW : Routing Number is undefined'); return; } if ( typeof(document.form1.XPath_ConfirmBankRoutingNumber) == 'undefined' ) { alert('DisableConfirmRoutingNumberISOGLCW : Confirm Routing Number is undefined'); return; } RoutingNumber = document.form1.XPath_EFTBankRoutingNumber; Confirm = document.form1.XPath_ConfirmBankRoutingNumber; DisableFieldFocus(RoutingNumber,Confirm,"");
Script.Comment: Disable Confirm Routing number element when Routing number is blank.

Script.Name: InstallmentPaymentsISOGLCW
Script.Title: Installment payments
Script.Data: if ((typeof(document.form1.XPath_PaymentPlan) != 'undefined') && (typeof(document.form1.XPath_DownPaymentAmount) != 'undefined')) { if (typeof(document.form1.XPath_FollowOnPaymentType) != 'undefined') { var InstType = document.form1.XPath_FollowOnPaymentType; if (InstType.value == 'EFT') var FeeAmt = 0; else var FeeAmt = 5; } var PayPlan = document.form1.XPath_PaymentPlan; switch(PayPlan.value) { case 'Two Pay': var Percent = .50; var Dep = .50; break; case '4 Pay': var Percent = .20; var Dep = .40; break; case 'Monthly': var Percent = .083; var Dep = .083; break; } CalculatePayments(Dep,Percent,FeeAmt); }
Script.Comment: Call CalculatePayments script and pass required parameters.

Script.Comment: This script applies to the KidnapRansom risk level.

Script.Name: LessThanOneYear
Script.Title: Less Than One Year
Script.Data: /* If the number of days between Crime.PolEffDt and Crime.PolExpDt is < 1 year, set Crime.LessThanOneYear on Policy page = Yes. If >= 1 year, set Crime.LessThanOneYear = No */
Script.Comment: This script will determine if the policy is less than one year by comparing the policy effective date and the policy expiration date. If the policy is short term, then a value of Yes needs to be set to the Crime.LessThanOneYear field. If it is not less than one year, then the value of No must be set to this field.

Script.Name: LimitOfInsNullMessage
Script.Title: Limit Of Insurance Null Message
Script.Comment: This script will display the message "Limit Of Insurance Must Be Entered For Insuring Agreement Selected." when CrimeInsuringAgreement.LimitOfIns field = "Null" and the CrimeInsuringAgreement.Type <> "Lessees Of Safe Deposit Boxes", "Employee Theft - Name Schedule", "Employee Theft - Position Schedule" or "Securities Deposited With Others". Also, set focus to CrimeInsuringAgreement.Deduct field when CrimeInsuringAgreement.Type <> "Lessees Of Safe Deposit Boxes", "Employee Theft - Name Schedule", "Employee Theft - Position Schedule" or "Securities Deposited With Others" AND CrimeInsuringAgreement.LimitOfIns field <> "Null".

Script.Name: LimitOfInsSetFocusSetValue
Script.Title: Set Focus/Set Value for Limit of Insurance
Script.Comment: This script will set focus to CrimeInsuringAgreement.LimitOfIns field when the CrimeInsuringAgreement.Type <> "Lessees Of Safe Deposit Boxes", "Employee Theft - Name Schedule", "Employee Theft - Position Schedule" or "Securities Deposited With Others". If CrimeInsuringAgreement.Type = "Lessees Of Safe Deposit Boxes", "Employee Theft - Name Schedule", "Employee Theft - Position Schedule" or "Securities Deposited With Others", then set the CrimeInsuringAgreement.LimitOfIns field and CrimeInsuringAgreement.Deduct field to "0".

Script.Name: PolicyTerm
Script.Title: Policy Term
Script.Data: /* Calculate the number of years between the Crime.EffectiveDt and Crime.ExpirationDt. If the number of years = 2 and the Crime.CoverageFormType <> Government Crime Coverage Form (Discovery Form), Government Crime Coverage Form (Loss Sustained Form), Government Crime Policy (Discovery Form) or Government Crime Policy (Loss Sustained Form, display message "Policy term is invalid for the Coverage Form Type selected." The Crime.CoverageFormType field should be cleared */
Script.Comment: This script will determine if the Crime.CoverageFormType selected is valid for the Crime.EffectiveDt and Crime.ExpirationDt entered. If an invalid Crime.CoverageFormType is selected for the policy term a message should display and the Crime.CoverageFormType field should be cleared. The page name is Policy.

Script.Name: setDownPaymentISOGLCW
Script.Title: set down payment field
Script.Data: if ((typeof(document.form1.XPath_DownPaymentAmount)!='undefined') || (typeof(document.form1.XPath_DownPaymentAmountValidation)!='undefined')) { var Fld = document.form1.XPath_DownPaymentAmount; var hFld = document.form1.XPath_DownPaymentAmountValidation; hFld.value = Fld.value; }
